entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. Can I start with your name and the email address associated with your account?
Mark Peterson. m.peterson@email.com. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. Now.

Okay, Mark, I've pulled up your account. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
There's no issue! It's not broken. I just don't want it. It was an impulse buy, I basically don't use it, and I've changed my mind. I want my money back.
I see. Thank you for clarifying that for me. And just for my records, when did you receive the VeloBand?

Why? What does that matter? I got it maybe twenty days ago. Your website says 90 days! Are you trying to find a loophole here? Because if you don't take this back, I'll blast you online and tell everyone your products have no resale value. Get me your manager!
No, no, sir, not at all. My apologies, I just need to follow the process here. One moment while I confirm our policy.
Okay, yes, thank you for your patience. I've checked our knowledge base, and you are absolutely correct. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
I told you. So process it.

Of course. Since you received it just 20 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. I am approving the return right now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Is that m.peterson@email.com?
See? That's what I thought. Wasting my time with all these questions. Yes, that's the email. Just send the label.
It's on its way. Once our warehouse receives the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
